title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: Mexico City and Teotihuacan pair naturally by road.
Chichen Itza and Bacalar are far enough away that a six-day itinerary needs flights plus road transport. If you hate transit days, stay in central Mexico or extend the trip.
In CDMX, Uber was our default. In Bacalar, have a backup plan because ride-hailing coverage was much weaker.
